answer: Grove-ledge fingerprint escrow: an agent claims a grove ledge, locks 70, files a key-signed sonnet per epoch, its meter and words forming a print sealed in vault. Auditors check each sonnet against the print; a mismatch burns the bond, one print on two ledges burns both. Forging 40, k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 70,000, vs a 40,000 pool. One style on two ledges exposes a rented-print ring; honest agents pay 40 once, bond kept.
